title: Camille & Eden
description: Eden has doubts about Camille, who's becoming more and more distant...

questions.question: So… Is Camille using a dating app? If yes, tell me which one please.
questions.hint: Look at the apps installed on the phone.

questions.question: Damn okay, so it was true... And honestly, how many hours a week do you think she spends on Hinge?
questions.hint: Check in the phone settings, there's the screen time.

questions.question: 3 hours?? I hope it’s only virtual… Can you check if she already met someone in real life? Tell me his first name if you find it.
questions.hint: Check the Hinge conversations and Instagram DMs. You can find a link with someone who keeps coming up, you'll find their name on Hinge.

questions.question: Can you dig around and tell me exactly when they saw each other? I need a precise date please.
questions.hint: Look for a photo of their first date.

questions.question: Whoa, that escalated fast… How many days passed between their match and their first meeting?
questions.hint: Calculate the number of days between the match and the date.

questions.question: I bet they kept talking somewhere else… Do you see which other app they use to chat?
questions.hint: Check the other social networks where they communicate, outside of Hinge.

questions.question: Okay, I want to know who this Daniel really is. Looking at his profiles, can you tell me his job?
And how old is this guy? Check his personal info please.
Can you tell me where he’s from? His origin, his country…
I need to understand what connects them… What’s his passion or his thing?
questions.hint: Read their conversations to find their common passion.

questions.question: Wait, I want to know how long Camille has been on Hinge… Can you find when she registered please?
Tell me they didn’t exchange numbers… If they did, give me Daniel’s number.
questions.hint: Look in the contacts, Daniel or his nickname is probably there.

questions.question: Okay I really need to know… Could you tell if they already... did it? If yes, tell me when please..
questions.hint: Check the Health app, the BPM and sleep were higher during one evening.

questions.question: Damn, Daniel was already a month ago… She definitely kept going elsewhere. Find me another guy she’s cheating with, I’m sure there are more.
questions.hint: There's a secret app on the phone, you need to look at all the apps carefully.

textSuccess: Damn... Thanks for everything. I would've preferred to be wrong but now it's clear. With his number I'll be able to have a little chat with Daniel.

onboardingContent.text:
Hey... They told me you're the best person for stalking.
I really need help right now.

I've been with Camille for 2 years. We met in a bar, I had never felt that before.
We planned to move to Barcelona together this summer. Our tickets are already booked.

But a week ago, my roommate Lucas told me he thinks he saw her on a dating app.
At first I didn't believe him, I told him he was messing around.
But since then I can't stop thinking about it... What if it's true?

Last night, she left her phone unlocked on the table while she was in the shower.
I hesitated but... I copied all her data onto my computer.
Here, you'll see everything. Tell me what she's hiding.

messages.text: Hey Camille! I like your energy
What are you doing this weekend?
I was thinking brunch on Sunday with friends
There's a new spot in the 11th that looks cool
Yeah apparently it's stylish! They have insane pancakes
Haha we agree! So what do you do for a living?
Digital marketing! And for you, what does consulting mean exactly?
I help companies optimize their processes
Yeah it's nice! Lots of travel though
A bit but I like discovering new cities
I get it! That's a pretty cool perk
Definitely! By the way I saw your photos on Hinge, you seem to love traveling too
Yeah I love it! Even if I don't leave as often as I'd like
Hi Camille! 😊 I loved your travel photos
You can tell you love adventure
Haha yeah I try to make the most of it
That's the right mindset! Life's too short
Exactly! Do you travel a lot?
Not as much as I'd like! But I love discovering new places
Where have you been so far?
Mostly around Europe! Spain, Italy, Portugal...
But I'd love to go to the US someday
Same! I've always dreamed of going
New York and LA especially! Must be insane
Are you more into movies or series?
Both! But I admit I'm hooked on series right now
Same! I just finished The Last of Us, it was crazy
Ah I haven't watched it yet! Is it good?
Really amazing! You should watch it
Okay you convinced me 😊 What are you doing this weekend?
Nothing planned yet! Maybe an exhibit
Same, nothing crazy! I like to go with the flow
Exactly! So tell me, what's your favorite spot in Paris?
The vibe is always great there, especially in summer
Oh yeah! I go there often too
Seems like we have the same taste 😊
Haha apparently! By the way, what kind of music do you listen to?
A bit of everything! Mostly electro and indie though
Do you go to concerts sometimes?
Yeah when I can! I love the vibe in small venues
Me too! It's so much more intimate
Exactly! Anyway, do you work out?
A bit of yoga and running! Nothing too intense
Nice! I run too, mostly along the Seine
Nice! Running with that view is motivating
Totally! We should go for a run together sometime 😊
Fair warning, I'm not super fast haha
Haha no worries! It's not a competition
So tell me something about you I don't know yet?
Hmm... I did theater when I was younger
Oh nice! Did you act in plays?
A few yeah! But it was a long time ago
That's so cool! You should get back into it
Maybe someday! And you, something I don't know about you?
Yeah! I learned when I was a kid
You'll have to play me a song someday 😊
With pleasure! I'm a bit rusty though
Haha thanks! Anyway, do you have siblings?
Yeah I have a little sister! She's 22
Yeah totally! We call each other a lot
That's cute! I have an older brother
Oh nice! Where does he live?
Yeah it is! So tell me, dog or cat person?
Dogs! I'd love to have one
Same! But it's complicated in Paris
Yeah I get it... Maybe someday!
What breed do you have in mind?
A golden retriever! They're so cute
Oh yeah! I love goldens too
We really have the same taste 😄
Absolutely! I love chatting with you
Oh yes! I'm super passionate about cars
Cars have been my thing since I was a kid
Oh yeah? So you really know your stuff?
Yeah I spend my time on car forums haha
I also love going to auto shows
That's a cool passion! I know nothing about it 😅
Haha no worries! But wait, aren't you kind of into cars too?
Well I started looking into it a little
Something about it weirdly attracts me
Oh yeah? That's cool! What interests you?
Not sure yet... maybe car design?
I saw some cars recently that stuck with me
Beautiful cars in the street! It's intriguing me more and more
That's awesome! Car design really is an art
Same for me, I started by admiring them in the street
Cool that we share that! Even if I'm just starting
I can explain tons of stuff if you want
Nice! Do you have a model you especially like?
I've always dreamed of owning a Porsche
It's the perfect balance between design and performance
Classy! Gotta have ambition in life 😏
I believe it! So what are you doing tonight?
Apparently 😊 I really like chatting with you
Me too! Do you have Instagram?
Yeah! @gashi.on, but I don't post often :)
Hi Camille! Designer here, love your style
Your photos have a real visual identity
Oh thanks! I pay attention to that
It shows! You have an eye for colors
That's the designer in you talking 😄
Haha maybe! Design is my life
What kind of design do you do?
Wow! Do you have a portfolio?
Yeah check my Instagram feed, all my projects are there
Oh cool! Do you like it?
Yeah it's nice! Sometimes a bit repetitive
